title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Blue Razz Gummy Bear 10ml E-Liquid
description: Blue Razz Gummy Bear from the JNP Bar Salts collection offers a deeply sweet, playful, and nostalgic confectionery profile. The vibrant, bold taste of rich Blue Raspberry is flawlessly layered into a smooth, sugary Gummy base. This combination expertly replicates the distinct chewy texture and satisfying sweetness of a classic sweet shop treat, delivering a reliably rich experience. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the sweet nostalgia of Blue Razz Gummy Bear, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the classic Double Apple Shisha or the refreshing Summer Dream.
